Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Sorrells
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver
Date: 02/01/2022
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 109 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Board of Pharmacy to approve and issue permits to qualified pharmacy intern/extern applicants by an estimated minimum of $65,000 annually for additional staff to administer the intern/extern permit program. However, the increased obligations would be offset, in whole or in part, by the following fees imposed on pharmacy interns and externs as determined by the Board: initial and biannual renewal permit fees in an amount not to exceed $100 and; (2) late fees, not to exceed $50 per month until renewed. Based on the current number of pharmacy intern/externs potentially eligible for this program, the permit fees could increase receipts to the board by an estimated maximum of $121,500 beginning in Fiscal Year 2024 and every even-numbered fiscal year thereafter.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions
